description: Hand-maintained block metadata for blocks/README.md and the block READMEs (tools/docs/generate-block-docs.mjs): what the repository can't tell (status, type, category, purpose, relationships). Keep it in step with the blocks.

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.purpose: Expandable question / answer or detail panels (native details / summary)

anchor-list.name: Anchor List
anchor-list.purpose: In-page navigation to section anchors, optionally sticky
anchor-list.variations: Sticky or static; Anchor Link items

button-block.name: Button
button-block.purpose: A link styled as a button, icon button or link button
button-block.variations: View (button, icon, link), Type (primary, secondary, tertiary), icon, alignment
button-block.replaces: the built-in Button component (Button (basic), no longer offered)

cards.name: Cards
cards.purpose: Manually authored cards with the List's presentation (grid or horizontal scroll)
cards.variations: Card style (image, panel, report, statistic, mixed), Card colour, layout per breakpoint

column-break.name: Column Break
column-break.purpose: Starts a column in a Columns Container or a Tab
column-break.variations: Additional tab options of its column

columns.name: Columns
columns.purpose: The built-in Columns block: columns of default content
columns.variations: Columns and rows of the built-in component
columns.deprecation: No longer offered in any filter; its definition stays so Columns authored before stay editable. Use the Columns Container (with Column Breaks) for new columns.

columns-container.name: Columns Container
columns-container.purpose: A section laid out in columns of default content and blocks
columns-container.variations: Columns per row, gap, vertical alignment, side by side from, BG Color
columns-container.replaces: the built-in Columns block for new content

conversation-canvas.name: Conversation Canvas
conversation-canvas.purpose: Search prompt with quick actions; one floating journey across header, page and footer
conversation-canvas.variations: Primary (sticky dock), Secondary, journey options, action styles

embed.name: Embed
embed.purpose: Third-party embeds (YouTube, Vimeo, X and other URLs) behind a privacy-friendly facade

filter-list.name: Filter List
filter-list.purpose: Filterable listing of the locale's pages from the query index
filter-list.variations: Layouts, card styles, filters, featured cards

footer.name: Footer
footer.purpose: Site footer bar on the footer reference page (copyright, links, Conversation Canvas)
footer.variations: Footer Link items; Conversation Canvas page

form-variations.name: Form Variations
form-variations.purpose: Forms (contact, download, subscribe) built from field items

fragment.name: Fragment
fragment.purpose: Includes the sections of another page

gen-carousel.name: Gen Carousel
gen-carousel.purpose: A section whose Heroes or Teasers rotate as slides

header.name: Header
header.purpose: Site header from the nav reference page: brand, menu sections, tools
header.variations: Desktop logo bar; tablet / mobile full-screen menu

hero.name: Hero
hero.purpose: Full-width banner with image or Lottie, title, description and CTAs
hero.variations: Views, nine positions, BG Color, animation

interactive-dashboard.name: Interactive Dashboard
interactive-dashboard.purpose: Reserved for a future dashboard; renders nothing on the site

list.name: List
list.purpose: Child pages, a fixed list or tagged pages from the query index, as cards or links
list.variations: Sources, card styles, layout per breakpoint, rows

modal.name: Modal
modal.purpose: Opens a page's content in a dialog (button or auto-linked /modals/ links)

page-header.name: Page Header
page-header.purpose: The title area of a page from its metadata (title, description, tags, author, dates)

media-contacts.name: Media Contacts
media-contacts.purpose: The media contacts of the locale's Media Contacts sheet, grouped by designation and region
media-contacts.variations: Title and Title Type; contacts of the page's region, else all
media-contacts.replaces: the Media contacts the press-release template appended (removed)

quote.name: Quote
quote.purpose: A quotation with author, optional image and title

separator.name: Separator
separator.variations: Variants, widths per breakpoint, theme, motion

tab.name: Tab
tab.purpose: Starts a tab panel in a Tabs Container
tab.variations: Columns per row of its Column Breaks

table.name: Table
table.purpose: A data table of rows with 1–9 columns

table-list.name: Table List
table-list.purpose: A numbered list of linked items (industries, services)

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.purpose: Tabs Container section (Tab items and content) and the Tabs block (tabs of fragments)

tcs-header.name: TCS Header
tcs-header.purpose: The TCS and TATA logos of the header, on the nav page

teaser.name: Teaser
teaser.purpose: Title, text, image and links in one of four layouts
teaser.variations: Layouts (Image & Text, Text split, Background image, Card), image positions, BG Color, styles

testimonial.name: Testimonial
testimonial.purpose: A client testimonial with author, image and stats

video.name: Video
video.purpose: A DAM, YouTube or Vimeo video inline or in a pop-up, with poster and captions
video.variations: Inline or pop-up, autoplay / loop options
